notes.title: Update v.0.-10
notes.content:
Hello everybody. A new update has been released.
[b]In this update[/b], I fixed a bug with a task that was not running before.
A [b]new location[/b] has been added where you can sell sweets for the best price.
A [b]candy market[/b] has been added with which you can sell sweets more profitably.
Added animation of sale dialogs.
The laboratory model has been replaced with a more practical and animated one.
The game is growing and evolving. With the help of your support and your letters, I fix bugs and make innovations. 
[b]Thank you very much to those who purchased the game. There will only be more content to come. Thank you.[/b]

notes.title: Update v.0.-29
notes.content:
Hello everybody. A new update has been released, in which all the noticed bugs were fixed, noticed not only by me, but also by you, informing me about it, everything was fixed.
[b]New features have been added to the game.[/b] 
The players were waiting for the fact that the game is not clear what to do. I fixed this by adding not only an almanac that describes all the game processes, but also added tasks that you can complete as the game progresses. 
[b]Orders have also been added[/b], which will appear from time to time. You can do them and get paid for it. Soon, it is planned to add the following, these are new locations, interaction with the police and everything related to this bureaucracy. 
[b]Thanks again to those people[/b] who became interested and believed in my project, who bought the game, thank you very much.
[b]I assure you that you made[/b] the right choice, and more and more new features will be added to the game. Also, don't forget to email me with any bugs you find. Of course, do not forget about the innovations that you would like to see in the game, all letters are read and satisfied. Once again, many thanks to those who supported my project, further - more.
